# ICA source fixtures

These are secret-free, trimmed examples based on
`.scratch/offers-v1/research/ica-offer-data-access.md`. The Berga store and
“Småcitrus i nät” offer preserve the observed public response fields. The
anonymous-token value is a nonfunctional test placeholder, not a credential.
Other stores and Offers are synthetic cases for city matching, mechanics,
categories and validity boundaries. The HTML includes unrelated JavaScript
`undefined` state to model the observed hydration page without evaluating it.

Automated tests replay these files through an injected fetcher. They make no
network requests.
